text: 1. Period of Study The Period of Study lasts for 2 years. Students will have a full-time study in the first year to finish all the courses in China University of Political Science and Law in Beijing. In the second year, after their registration the students can manage their time independently to carry on social internship in China or in their own country, and prepare the research paper by keeping in touch with their thesis adviser. 2. Fees Application fee is 800 RMB per person; The whole tuition fee is 99,000 RMB in total per person. The tuition fee will be paid by year: 50,000 RMB in the first year; 49,000 RMB in the second year. Pre-pay tuition is 2000 RMB per person, which is included in the whole tuition fee. 3.Accommodations Students will live in the International Students’ apartments arranged by the university, and the accomodation fee will be funded by themselves. All the admitted student will get a special scholarship provided by the university, which will be used to reduce the accommodation expenses. 4.Application and Admission Time Students can submit application materials at any time of the year; the Admission Time is in each September. 5.
